meta.title: Public speech claim ledger — pressure-campaign inventory
meta.method: Inventory of PUBLIC claims by named speakers. Each row is a claim ticket: what was said, who said it, a primary URL when banked, and a verification status. A ticket is not a finding that the claim is true.
meta.disclaimer: TENET5 does not promote unproven employment, criminal, or intelligence-affiliation claims as fact. Third-party assertions stay ALLEGATION until independently verified from primary records.

campaign.display: Barrett Brown (public byline on linked posts)
campaign.frame: Visible 2026 public naming and pressure campaign aimed at overlapping online-scene accounts. Mapping the campaign organizes speech; it does not endorse each claim.
methods: Screenshot posts of purported private or third-party speech
